geography_scope: Selected Mumbai Metropolitan Region station catchments: Central, Western, Harbour
contact_policy: Reserved .test emails; phone fields empty; no household addresses
clinical_policy: Invented labels and overlapping observations, no clinical validation; prescription placeholders only
classification: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY - NOT OBSERVED PATIENT DATA

reference_metadata.description: Curated real station-area anchors for a synthetic Mumbai Metropolitan Region patient dataset; no patient or residential coordinates.
reference_metadata.coordinate_system: WGS84 geographic coordinates in decimal degrees, extracted from KML Point coordinates.
reference_metadata.coordinate_transform: KML longitude,latitude reordered to named longitude/latitude fields; retained to six decimal places. Dadar uses an explicit mean of its two source points.
reference_metadata.coordinate_precision_note: Decimal precision preserves the source anchor; it is not a guarantee of surveyed positional accuracy or a household location.
reference_metadata.line_membership_method: Curated corridor memberships cross-checked against official route references. KML N_REGION is a single source category and is not copied as a complete membership list.
reference_metadata.line_membership_note: Trans-Harbour, Uran, Metro and non-suburban services are outside this classification. Interchange memberships overlap; sum of per-line counts can exceed unique station or patient counts.
reference_metadata.city_label_note: Broad city/urban-region labels for this synthetic dataset, not municipal boundary claims. Navi Mumbai includes the Panvel station area; Kalyan and Dombivli share Kalyan-Dombivli.

official_line_sources.description: Central Railway Mumbai Division system map, page 1, effective 2019-04-01; station topology and interchange cross-check, not current timetable.
Western Railway official suburban station sequence, dated 2023-04-05; includes Churchgate, Dadar, Bandra, Andheri, Goregaon and Borivali.
Ministry of Railways/PIB 2018-07-03 release refers to Harbour lines at Andheri-Vile Parle and Goregaon-CSMT service.
Ministry of Railways/PIB 2026-03-25 project list includes the sanctioned Goregaon-Borivali Harbour extension; this reference does not establish operation to Borivali.

limitations: Selected station areas only; not an exhaustive station registry, current timetable or routing service.
The source catalog attributes the coordinate resource to BMC; this subset does not independently certify its survey accuracy.
Any generated patient points must be separately labelled synthetic and must not be described as observed residence, travel or disease exposure.
Stations were selected for geographic and line coverage, not in proportion to population, ridership or disease incidence.

credentials: Excluded from shareable files; stored under ignored .local/synthetic/<dataset_id>/credentials.json
generation_reproducibility: Public dataset bytes repeat for the same generator/reference/seed/date; credentials are cryptographically random each run.
